entities.summary: Robert Reinick was a German painter and poet, associated with the Düsseldorf school of painting. One of his poems, Dem Vaterland, was set to music by Hugo Wolf and another, The Flight into Egypt was the libretto for a cantata by Max Bruch. He wrote the libretto to Schumann's opera Genoveva. Robert Reinick was a poets & playwrights from Gdańsk (1805-02-22, Gdańsk–1852-02-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
